applied.problem: "Two equal balls that stick lose half their kinetic energy" holds only when one starts still; two equal balls meeting head-on at equal speeds and sticking lose all of it. Heat in the wiring is most, not all, of the capacitor loss.

"Neither quantity is kept ball by ball" reads as never, yet two equal balls meeting at equal speeds in a bouncy hit each keep their kinetic energy; and "kept in every hit" alone is false off a cushion, so it needs its no-outside-push condition on a review card.
Screen 4 invites any pull-back speed from 0.5 to 4.0 m/s, so the total arrow stays the same but is 0.4 kg m/s only for the 2.0 m/s shot.
